_comment: Analysis tuning for Traceline. Every value here is the built-in default, so a run with
no --weights is identical to a run with this file. Copy it, edit what you need, and pass
it with `--weights path/to/file.json`. Unknown keys are rejected on purpose: a misspelled
threshold must not leave you believing you set something you did not.

windows._comment: How much history is baseline and where the incident starts.

anomaly._comment: When a service counts as having changed behaviour.

weights._comment: Factor weights. They must sum to 1.0 so a perfect candidate scores exactly 1.0.

confidence._comment: Score and margin thresholds for the high/medium/low label.
